findings.detail: iam:PassRole granted on Resource: * via action(s) ['*']. Allows passing any IAM role to any AWS service. Demonstrated exploit: attach admin role to EC2 and retrieve credentials via Instance Metadata Service.

iam:PassRole granted on Resource: * via action(s) ['iam:PassRole', 'ec2:RunInstances', 'ec2:DescribeInstances', 'ec2:CreateTags']. Allows passing any IAM role to any AWS service. Demonstrated exploit: attach admin role to EC2 and retrieve credentials via Instance Metadata Service.

iam:PassRole granted on Resource: * via action(s) ['iam:*']. Allows passing any IAM role to any AWS service. Demonstrated exploit: attach admin role to EC2 and retrieve credentials via Instance Metadata Service.

iam:PassRole granted on Resource: * via action(s) ['*']. Allows passing any IAM role to any AWS service. Demonstrated exploit: attach admin role to EC2 and retrieve credentials via Instance Metadata Service.

Action(s) ['iam:*'] granted on Resource: *. Grants full IAM control — principal can attach AdministratorAccess to themselves in a single API call. Demonstrated exploit: aws iam attach-user-policy with AdministratorAccess.

Role lab-chain-role-a is trusted to assume lab-chain-role-b. lab-chain-role-b holds: ['AdministratorAccess']. CRITICAL: lab-chain-role-b has AdministratorAccess — this chain leads to full admin privileges.
